events.name: Friday Night Live - Improv Comedy Miami Show
events.info: Friday Night Live! - Improv Comedy in Miami Show It's JTF's special combination of shortform and longform improv! Enjoy as our award winning cast brings you fantastic improv that's perfect for your Friday night...LIVE! Our shows are often described as fast-paced improvised comedy. Think of it as Whose Line is It Anyway meets SNL with a lot of fun audience interaction along the way. Come be a part of the fun! Tickets are PER PERSON for this show. We will seat parties together in tables. We will do our best to sit larger groups as close as possible, but may have to split large groups if they arrive late. Tickets are NON REFUNDABLE after purchase. The show STARTS at 9pm and ENDS at around 10:50pm. Pre-show bar opens at 7:30pm with a pre-show stage show at 8pm at no additional cost if you want to arrive early.

events.name: The BIG Show Improv Comedy Miami
events.info: The Big Show - Improv Comedy in Miami It's our signature show: Live, fast-paced improvised comedy at its best. Think of it as Whose Line is It Anyway meets SNL! The Big Show is interactive improv comedy, featuring our talented and award-winning cast. Come be a part of the fun! Tickets are PER PERSON for this show. We will seat parties together in tables. We will do our best to sit larger groups as close as possible, but may have to split large groups if they arrive late. Tickets are NON REFUNDABLE after purchase. The show STARTS at 9pm and ENDS between 10:45pm and 10:55pm. Coming early? Admission for this show includes access to the shorter One Hot Hour show that starts at 8pm in our adjacent bar/cantina Spotlight stage.

events.info: CRIMEWAVE: A GOTH, POST-PUNK & DARKWAVE PARTY Miami! Dive into the shadows and lose yourself to CRIMEWAVE - a night of your favorite goth, darkwave, new wave, post-punk, and industrial music Dress to impress and dance into the darkness at: Churchill's Pub Saturday, November 28 10pm 21+ DJ @misspurple.mp3 will be spinning music from the likes of Depeche Mode, The Cure, Nine Inch Nails, Mareux, Molchat Doma, Boy Harsher, and so much more! Your night awaits @thedanceparties
